rules.description: Irv — Hyper Key (Navigation, Selection, Rectangle, App Launchers, System Utilities)

manipulators.description: Hyper + Shift + A → Select word left
Hyper + 0 → Toggle Drum Pad Mode ON

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'display notification "Drum Pad ON — keys A-L are now drums!" with title "🥁 Drum Mode"'

manipulators.description: Hyper + 0 → Toggle Drum Pad Mode OFF

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'display notification "Drum Pad OFF — back to normal typing" with title "🥁 Drum Mode"'

rules.description: Irv — Drum Pad Mode (toggle with Hyper+0)
